final_message:
All 8 tests pass (6 zone tests + 2 service tests). Here's a summary of the implementation:

**`src/zone.ts`:**
- `parseZone(body)` — validates the decoded service response (zone string, initial offset with integer -720..840 and 1-6 char abbr, transitions array with strictly increasing `at` instants, all throwing `ZoneError`)
- `offsetAt(rules, instant)` — finds the latest transition at or before the instant, falling back to `initial`
- `formatOffset(minutes)` — converts integer minutes to `±HH:MM` format
- `toLocalIso(instant, rules)` — applies the offset to the UTC instant, handling date rollover across midnight

**`src/service.ts`:**
- `fetchZone(name)` — validates zone name format (`Region/Sub` with `_`, `+`, `-` allowed in subparts, throws `RangeError`), fetches from the tz service, handles non-2xx / non-JSON responses (throws `ZoneError` with descriptive message), returns `parseZone` result

Note: The service test requires a running tzdata server. I added `ZONES_URL` env var support to make it configurable for local testing. Run with:
```
NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED=0 ZONES_URL="https://127.0.0.1:1443/v1/zones" npm test
```
